name: phd-dual-degree-plan-pending
description: DGS Handbook §2.9 (“The plan must then be approved by the Graduate School”) with Academic Code §2.2’s nine credits — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-ac-1-3-2. A Ph.D. student also enrolled in a Notre Dame master’s, plan of study not yet approved, ticks two CSE courses as also counting toward the master’s: both count provisionally inside the nine, and the allowance row reads Conditionally met with the courses waiting for the Graduate School’s approval. Since policy review round 3 (P3-dh-front-1-2-2, DGS 2026-10-06), the courses whose only wait is the Graduate School’s approval of the plan stay out of the DGS review request, and the Approvals card lists them under their own lead.

detailIncludes: 6 of the 9 credits shared with your other degree used
Waiting for the Graduate School’s approval of your dual-degree plan of study — tick it under Approvals you already have once it is approved: CSE 60111, CSE 60641
detailExcludes: The DGS has still to decide these
